long_biography.plain_text:
Vanguard Limited joined Britain's Register of Overseas Entities in 2023 as a company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands. One of the people recorded as controlling it is Antoine Tarazi, born in December 1985 and holding above a quarter of the equity. That combination of name, nationality and age separates him from several older namesakes.

Nothing in the entry explains what Vanguard owns or does. Nor does it assign Tarazi an executive or board position. Share control alone cannot reveal whether he created the vehicle, participates in its management or holds the stake passively. His profession and the source, purpose and wider context of his capital are consequently undetermined.
